segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures, sells and services avionics products and systems for retrofit applications and OEMs serving commercial, military and general aviation customers.
segments.evidence: We operate in one business segment that designs, develops, manufactures, sells and services avionics products and systems for retrofit applications and Original Equipment Manufacturers ("OEMs").

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling avionics products and systems to OEMs building new aircraft and to retrofit-market customers including the DoD, defense contractors, aircraft operators and modification centers.
revenueModel.evidence: We are able to market our products to both original equipment manufacturers that are building new aircraft and customers participating in the retrofit market.
